paragraphs.text: Aysha U. Farah is an American science fiction writer and game developer. She has had work published in Uncanny Magazine , Anathema Magazine , and FORESHADOW Anthology, and works as a narrative director for What Pumpkin Games .
Aysha U. Farah contributed to the Magic Story for Strixhaven: School of Mages , Innistrad: Crimson Vow , , Phyrexia: All Will Be One , and Secrets of Strixhaven .
